subjects.note: Probe: 0.888/0.413/0.674 - will sometimes cross the enter threshold. MATTE 2026-09-14: was 0.888/0.413/0.674 at 1.5/2.5/3.5 m (mirrored floor, 0.70 bar). [probe key: float/clean = champion float net via build_scene.py --preview preprocessing; chip = firmware preprocess + model_id_dory.onnx; himax = himax_typical camera, mean of 2 draws; single-subject probe = this cutout alone, static, straight ahead, camera on the eye line; full tables in docs/eval_results/2026-09-14-scene-notes]
